param.label: Abundance BIOM file with taxonomic affiliations (.biom)
param.help: BIOM file containing ASV abundances and their associated taxonomic annotations.

param.label: Sample metadata file (.tsv)
param.help: TSV file containing metadata describing each sample (e.g., condition, batch, environment).

param.label: Phylogenetic tree file (.nwk)
param.help: Optional Newick file containing the phylogenetic tree generated by the FROGS Core Tree tool.

param.value: Kingdom Phylum Class Order Family Genus Species
param.label: Names of taxonomic levels
param.help: The ordered taxonomic levels stored in BIOM. Each level is separated by one space

param.label: Do you want to normalize your data ?
param.help: Choose whether to normalize read abundances before performing statistical analyses (default: No).
param.option: Yes, subsample abundances to match the smallest sample size.
